message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "# This workflow will do a clean install of node dependencies, build the source code and run tests across different versions of node
# For more information see: https://help.github.com/actions/language-and-framework-guides/using-nodejs-with-github-actions

name: CI

on: [push, 'pull_request']

jobs:
  build:
    name: CI
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5

    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [14.x]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0 # 👈 Required to retrieve git history

      - name: Use Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}

      - name: Cache node modules
        id: node-cache
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        env:
          cache-name: cache-node-modules
        with:
          path: node_modules
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-node-modules-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-node-modules-

      - name: Install Dependencies
        if: steps.node-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: npm install

      - name: Run all checks
        run: npm run check",
  "rationale": "The P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT pattern is supported by measured experiment evidence (experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508) showing that adding timeout-minutes: 5 reduced median elapsed time from 41s to 30s (26.8% savings) with identical success (3/3). The repository's CI history shows representative successful runs of roughly 24-33 seconds, satisfying the precondition that representative successful-duration history exists, and a 5-minute budget provides about 10x headroom so valid slow runs are unlikely to exceed it. The change only bounds job duration; it preserves all steps, build/test coverage, permissions, and adds no privileged actions, secrets, publishing/deployment operations, or new network access.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508", "pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT"]
}
